name: AJx Filter for WooCommerce
author: Jahid Shah

sections.description:
AJx Filter for WooCommerce is a powerful and lightweight WooCommerce product filtering plugin that allows users to filter products dynamically using AJAX without refreshing the page. Perfect for WooCommerce stores looking to enhance the customer shopping experience, increase conversions, and improve product navigation.

Key Features:
* Filter products by taxonomies (categories, tags, custom taxonomies) and attributes.
* Dynamic AJAX filtering for fast and seamless browsing.
* Fully customizable product layout (columns, product per row, product per page).
* Customizable “Buy Now” button text.
* Inline CSS customization for product container, button, and sidebar colors.
* Compatible with any WordPress theme.
* Responsive design and mobile-friendly filters.
* Translation-ready and fully WPML compatible.

Requirements

  1. Must have WooCommerce installed and activated.
  2. WordPress version 5.5 or higher.
  3. PHP version 7.4 or higher.

Customization

AJx Filter for WooCommerce offers extensive customization options directly via the WordPress Customizer, allowing you to change the look and feel of your filters and products in real time. No coding is required. You can customize:

  • Filter Section Background – Change the background color of the filter section.
  • Filter Collapse Container Background – Set the background color for collapsible filter groups.
  • Collapse Button Background & Hover – Style the collapse/expand buttons with normal and hover colors.
  • Collapse Button Font Color – Customize the text color of collapse buttons.
  • Collapse Container Font Size & Color – Adjust the font size and color of the filter titles.
  • Price Filter Button Color & Font Color – Customize the appearance of the price filter button.
  • Price Filter Font Size – Set the font size of the price filter button.
  • Products Container Background – Change the background of the product listing container.
  • Product Card Background – Set the background color for individual product cards.
  • Product Title Color & Font Size – Customize the color and size of product titles.
  • Product Price Color & Font Size – Adjust the display of product prices.
  • Product Button Background & Hover Color – Style the “Buy Now” buttons including hover effect.
  • Button Font Size & Color – Customize the text size and color of all buttons.

These options allow store owners to match the filter and product display with their theme design, improving aesthetics, readability, and user experience.

Additional Notes

This plugin improves the WooCommerce shopping experience by allowing your customers to quickly find the products they are looking for without page reloads. It is ideal for stores with large product catalogs, multiple attributes, and categories.

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 or later.

Support & Contact

If you encounter any issues or need support, please open a support ticket via the WordPress plugin repository or visit our support page.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ajx-woofilter directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to the plugin settings page to configure your filters:
    • Set the number of products per row.
    • Set the number of products per page.
    • Customize the “Buy Now” button text.
  4. Add the AJx Filter for WooCommerce shortcode [ajxfiltrfrwo] to any page or post to display the filter.
sections.faq:
How do I add the filter to my page?

Use the shortcode [ajxfiltrfrwo] on any page or post where you want the filter to appear.

Can I customize the appearance of products?

Yes! You can customize colors, font sizes, and product layout from the plugin settings or using the WordPress Customizer.

Is it compatible with all themes?

Yes, the plugin uses standard WooCommerce templates and inline CSS, so it works with any WooCommerce-compatible theme.

Does it support AJAX filtering?

Absolutely! All filtering happens dynamically without reloading the page.
